as_told.title: Grandfather's 1916 graffiti at the top of the Great Pyramid
as_told.place_text: top of the Great Pyramid, south side, Giza

plain: An author named Graham Hancock says that when he climbed the Great Pyramid in Egypt, he and Santha Faiia, who was with him, found a carving near the top that read "P Hancock, 5th of April 1916." He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that this was his grandfather, Philip Hancock, whose diaries back up the visit. In one telling he puts the name at the top, and in another one step down from the top on the south side. For Hancock, it is a personal link between his family and the ancient monument he has spent years writing about.
